14.9 Taylor’s Formula for Two Variables

In this section we use Taylor’s formula to derive the Second Derivative Test for local extreme values (Section 14.7) and the error formula for linearizations of functions of two independent variables (Section 14.6). The use of Taylor’s formula in these derivations leads to an extension of the formula that provides polynomial approximations of all orders for functions of two independent variables.
